projectDescription: An AI-powered job search dashboard that helps job seekers tailor resumes, track applications, and analyze their career search with built-in Kanban and analytics.
keyFeatures: Multi-profile candidate management for different career tracks
AI resume tailoring using Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Qwen, or local Ollama models
Job match scoring with keyword analysis and gap identification
Kanban board for tracking applications across Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offered, and Rejected stages
Daily application goals with progress tracking in the header
Analytics dashboard with application trends, resume version performance, and activity heatmaps
One-click resume export to PDF and DOCX formats
Automatic job description fetching from a URL
publicApiSurface: Dashboard: KPI cards (Total Applications, Interviews, Offers, Conversion Rate) with 7-day sparklines
Generate Resume: job description input via URL fetch or paste, AI model selection, keyword analysis, match scoring, resume editor with version history
Applications: full-page Kanban board with drag-to-move between stages
Analytics: weekly application trends, resume version interview rate, status distribution chart, activity heatmap
Master Profile: CRUD for candidate profiles including skills, work experience, education, projects, and certifications
Settings: daily goal configuration, appearance, and database connection diagnostics
